g.text: MarieRank5Convo5 begins.

g.title: j20182927
g.text: Check boolean MarieDating

g.title: j2438415941
g.text: Bonjour, bonjour, mon cœur ! I have to tell you the silliest thing.

g.title: j20182927->j2438415941
g.text: true

g.title: j2480201904
g.text: Bonjour ! I have to tell you the silliest thing.

g.title: j20182927->j2480201904
g.text: false

g.title: j3715580324
g.text: Oh? What happened?

g.title: j242691715
g.text: [End.]

g.title: j402847595
g.text: I asked M'sieur Bird Trois what his birthday was, and he did not know ! How terribly sad !

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j261110602
g.text: None of the Cavia know their birthdays, which I suppose makes sense, given that they were born without the ability to speak or know the calendrier as we do.

g.title: j4042041477
g.text: So I thought, what a tragédie ! We must right this at once, non ?

g.title: j121202655
g.text: I never thought about that.

g.title: j3730322367
g.text: How will you discover when they were born?

g.title: j4091678850
g.text: Will you let them pick their birthdays?

g.title: j2728169168
g.text: Oui ! Neither had Monsieur Loid. The look on his face when I discovered this was of pure sorrow...

g.title: j1191292463
g.text: At first, I thought to check le Cardinal's records - perhaps he recorded when they were born, oui ?

g.title: j3553632443
g.text: "Let ?" You say it as if it is up to me !

g.title: j355260187
g.text: It breaks my heart that he thinks it is his fault for not thinking of it first. It is not his fault, he does so much for so many...

g.title: j2402114516
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j4154024463
g.text: We are all blessed to know the kindness of Monsieur Loid. The depth of the well he draws from knows no end.

g.title: j1945792765
g.text: But then I remembered... my conversations with M'sieur Tagfer, and the others, and I thought... that may not be so wise.

g.title: j2402114516->j1945792765
g.text: MarieEntratiComplete

g.title: j2402114516->j1945792765
g.text: MarieEntrati3a

g.title: j4200274838
g.text: But they seemed uninterested in finding records of their past. I know how painful it can be, to think of one's origins.

g.title: j2402114516->j4200274838
g.text: false

g.title: j1995498182
g.text: We really are lucky he's here.

g.title: j4237964604
g.text: I just wish he'd cheer up a bit from time to time.

g.title: j1893600756
g.text: I do not know my own day of birth, after all.

g.title: j3216291545
g.text: Oui, that we are. That we all are.

g.title: j2538303403
g.text: He is a serious man, but I have seen him smile. There is humor in him, when one least expects it. One just has to be patient.

g.title: j3709850919
g.text: If it makes you feel any better, neither do I. I suspect the kid doesn't remember, either.

g.title: j3672014979
g.text: Birthdays are overrated.

g.title: j2559342319
g.text: It's more fun to pick your own, anyway. More poignant.

g.title: j3542593548
g.text: Check boolean MarieDating

g.title: j1552066127
g.text: More reasons to weep for you and your minuscule copie. Yet more things we have in common !

g.title: j1524743498
g.text: I do not believe they are overrated at all ! We must celebrate those that are still with us, the same that we celebrate those who are gone.

g.title: j960451503
g.text: Poignant ? I did not know you spoke any Gaullique ! Did you pick that up from me ?

g.title: j1931232019
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j3542593548->j1931232019
g.text: true

g.title: j3257135747
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j3542593548->j3257135747
g.text: false

g.title: j721135628
g.text: I... think it's just the same in both languages...

g.title: j1243924208
g.text: I must have picked it up from you.

g.title: j1084951341
g.text: Now ! Come along, mon cœur ! Even if nothing ever comes of this, it is always the thought that counts ! Au calendrier !

g.title: j505397393
g.text: Now ! Come along ! Even if nothing ever comes of this, it is the thought that counts ! Au calendrier !

g.title: j3322466742
g.text: Pff ! All the other languages are always stealing the best parts of Gaullique and running away with it ! Times will never change !

g.title: j1969145593
g.text: Then you are smart ! Gaullique is one of the most beautiful languages to ever be, and I am glad to bring it to this futur.
